'''Taru Durn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Theran]] and [[Oldtimer]], as well as the head of the healer hall of [[Hweg Shul]], [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. A [[Listener-Master|Master]] [[Theran Listener]], he taught [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] the technique of [[mnemotherapy]].
